title: Ghost Hand
synopsis: This is Part 3 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.

fullText.simplified:
一个小时后，这位霍桑大侦探来到了李时的家。李时、朱龙、小凤还有其他的下人都看着这位全国有名的大侦探，他们都感觉到，这位大侦探除了耳朵上的一块大红印记比较特别外，没有什么特别的地方。他的衣服很大很旧，鞋子也很脏。
    这位大侦探问了李时很多问题，然后坐在沙发上，想着这整件事情。他把李时说的话在脑中过了一遍。他想：昨天晚上一定有人进了他们的房间，想用迷药，迷倒睡在这床上的人。但不知道为什么，这件事没有做成。这个人有什么目的呢？偷东西吗？偷东西的话，这房间里有很多金手表、金手链，但都没有被偷走；杀人吗？杀人的话，应该也不会。如果要杀人，文华就不会只是发烧了。不是想偷东西，也不是想杀人，那么这个人进这个房间的目的到底是什么？
    霍桑边想边拿出一根烟，有一口没一口地吸着：主妇文华说，她是被第二次那只很冰的手完全惊醒的。那就是说，第一次的手，应该和常人没有什么区别，所以她并不害怕。进一步可以知道，昨天晚上进这个房间的，不止一个人，而是两个人。那为什么第二个人的手会那么冷呢？如果是这个屋子里面的人，屋子里有暖气，不应该会手冷。只有在两种情况下，才会手冷。第一种，是刚从外面进屋的人。因为现在是十二月，昨晚又下了雪，天很冷；第二种，是很瘦的人。这样的人，他的手在冬天里只会一直都是冷的。
    所以，现在可以知道：昨天晚上有两个人进了这个房间。一个是屋内人，一个是外来人。第一只手是屋内人的，第二只冷得像鬼的手，是外来人的。好一个里应外合！花那么大的功夫，他们到底有什么目的？
    想到这，霍桑抬起眼，扫了一遍屋里所有的人。他的视线在一胖一瘦两个人身上多停了几秒钟。
    李时看这位大侦探一直不说话，有点坐不住了。他问道：“请问霍先生，昨天晚上的事，是人干的还是鬼干的？”
    霍桑笑了笑，开玩笑似的说：“这件事太奇怪了，倒像是鬼干的。”
    “果真是鬼！那一定不会找上我。”李时突然这样说了一句。
    “为什么？”霍桑抬起眼来看他。
    “我脖子上戴着祖传的宝物，鬼可不敢来找我。”李时回答的时候，旁边有一个人干咳了一下，是那位很瘦的朱龙。
    “呀！宝物！在脖子里……”霍桑突然兴奋起来。他想：听说昨晚主人李时和主妇文华互换了睡觉的方向。而那黑暗中的手，又两次都是摸在主妇的脖子上。有没有可能，那两只怪手本来要摸的是主人李时的脖子，却误摸到了主妇的脖子上呢？
    “请问，那是一件什么宝物呢？”霍桑问道。这是这位大侦探进门以后第一次发出兴奋的声音。
    “那是我曾祖父留下来的东西，听说是他从外国带回来的。不是很值钱，但是有辟邪的作用。我从小戴在身上，就一直没有遇到过什么鬼啊怪啊的。”李时说。
    “可以给我看一下吗？”大侦探显得非常兴奋。
    李时想了想，说：“可以。那只是一条做工十分简单的小金龙。”他从他的脖子上取下了一条金链。在这金链上挂着一个黄色的小布袋，想必小金龙就藏在这布袋里面。
李时取下小布袋时，显得十分认真。霍桑正要接过布袋，李时的手却停了下来。
fullText.traditional:
一個小時後，這位霍桑大偵探來到了李時的家。李時、朱龍、小鳳還有其他的下人都看著這位全國有名的大偵探，他們都感覺到，這位大偵探除了耳朵上的一塊大紅印記比較特別外，沒有什麼特別的地方。他的衣服很大很舊，鞋子也很髒。
    這位大偵探問了李時很多問題，然後坐在沙發上，想著這整件事情。他把李時說的話在腦中過了一遍。他想：昨天晚上一定有人進了他們的房間，想用迷藥，迷倒睡在這床上的人。但不知道為什麼，這件事沒有做成。這個人有什麼目的呢？偷東西嗎？偷東西的話，這房間裡有很多金手錶、金手鏈，但都沒有被偷走；殺人嗎？殺人的話，應該也不會。如果要殺人，文華就不會只是發燒了。不是想偷東西，也不是想殺人，那麼這個人進這個房間的目的到底是什麼？
    霍桑邊想邊拿出一根煙，有一口沒一口地吸著：主婦文華說，她是被第二次那隻很冰的手完全驚醒的。那就是說，第一次的手，應該和常人沒有什麼區別，所以她並不害怕。進一步可以知道，昨天晚上進這個房間的，不止一個人，而是兩個人。那為什麼第二個人的手會那麼冷呢？如果是這個屋子裡面的人，屋子裡有暖氣，不應該會手冷。只有在兩種情況下，才會手冷。第一種，是剛從外面進屋的人。因為現在是十二月，昨晚又下了雪，天很冷；第二種，是很瘦的人。這樣的人，他的手在冬天裡只會一直都是冷的。
    所以，現在可以知道：昨天晚上有兩個人進了這個房間。一個是屋內人，一個是外來人。第一隻手是屋內人的，第二隻冷得像鬼的手，是外來人的。好一個裡應外合！花那麼大的功夫，他們到底有什麼目的？
    想到這，霍桑抬起眼，掃了一遍屋裡所有的人。他的視線在一胖一瘦兩個人身上多停了幾秒鐘。
    李時看這位大偵探一直不說話，有點坐不住了。他問道：“請問霍先生，昨天晚上的事，是人幹的還是鬼幹的？”
    霍桑笑了笑，開玩笑似的說：“這件事太奇怪了，倒像是鬼幹的。”
    “果真是鬼！那一定不會找上我。”李時突然這樣說了一句。
    “為什麼？”霍桑抬起眼來看他。
    “我脖子上戴著祖傳的寶物，鬼可不敢來找我。”李時回答的時候，旁邊有一個人乾咳了一下，是那位很瘦的朱龍。
    “呀！寶物！在脖子裡……”霍桑突然興奮起來。他想：聽說昨晚主人李時和主婦文華互換了睡覺的方向。而那黑暗中的手，又兩次都是摸在主婦的脖子上。有沒有可能，那兩隻怪手本來要摸的是主人李時的脖子，卻誤摸到了主婦的脖子上呢？
    “請問，那是一件什麼寶物呢？”霍桑問道。這是這位大偵探進門以後第一次發出興奮的聲音。
    “那是我曾祖父留下來的東西，聽說是他從外國帶回來的。不是很值錢，但是有辟邪的作用。我從小戴在身上，就一直沒有遇到過什麼鬼啊怪啊的。”李時說。
    “可以給我看一下嗎？”大偵探顯得非常興奮。
    李時想了想，說：“可以。那只是一條做工十分簡單的小金龍。”他從他的脖子上取下了一條金鏈。在這金鏈上掛著一個黃色的小布袋，想必小金龍就藏在這布袋裡面。
李時取下小布袋時，顯得十分認真。霍桑正要接過布袋，李時的手卻停了下來。

sentences.simplified: 想到这，霍桑抬起眼，扫了一遍屋里所有的人。
sentences.traditional: 想到這，霍桑抬起眼，掃了一遍屋裡所有的人。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè huò sāng tái qǐ yǎn sǎo le yí biàn wū lǐ suǒ yǒu de rén
sentences.english: When he had thought this far, Huo Sang lifted his gaze and swept it over everyone in the room.

sentences.simplified: 他的视线在一胖一瘦两个人身上多停了几秒钟。
sentences.traditional: 他的視線在一胖一瘦兩個人身上多停了幾秒鐘。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shì xiàn zài yí pàng yí shòu liǎng ge rén shēn shang duō tíng le jǐ miǎo zhōng
sentences.english: His look stopped for a few more seconds on two people, one fat and one thin.

sentences.simplified: 李时看这位大侦探一直不说话，有点坐不住了。
sentences.traditional: 李時看這位大偵探一直不說話，有點坐不住了。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí kàn zhè wèi dà zhēn tàn yì zhí bù shuō huà yǒu diǎn zuò bú zhù le
sentences.english: All the while Li Shi looked at this great detective without saying anything, and couldn’t sit still.

sentences.simplified: 他问道：“请问霍先生，昨天晚上的事，是人干的还是鬼干的？”
sentences.traditional: 他問道：“請問霍先生，昨天晚上的事，是人幹的還是鬼幹的？”
sentences.pinyin: tā wèn dào qǐng wèn huò xiān sheng zuó tiān wǎn shang de shì shì rén gàn de hái shi guǐ gàn de
sentences.english: He asked: “Excuse me, Mr. Huo, may I ask, that thing last night, was it done by a human or a ghost?”

sentences.simplified: 霍桑笑了笑，开玩笑似的说：
sentences.traditional: 霍桑笑了笑，開玩笑似的說：
sentences.pinyin: huò sāng xiào le xiào kāi wán xiào shì de shuō
sentences.english: Huo Sang smiled a bit, and said rather jokingly:

sentences.simplified: “这件事太奇怪了，倒像是鬼干的。”
sentences.traditional: “這件事太奇怪了，倒像是鬼幹的。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì tài qí guài le dào xiàng shì guǐ gàn de
sentences.english: “This matter is so strange, it really is as if done by a ghost.”

sentences.simplified: “果真是鬼！那一定不会找上我。”李时突然这样说了一句。
sentences.traditional: “果真是鬼！那一定不會找上我。”李時突然這樣說了一句。
sentences.pinyin: guǒ zhēn shì guǐ nà yí dìng bú huì zhǎo shàng wǒ lǐ shí tū rán zhè yàng shuō le yí jù
sentences.english: “So it’s really a ghost! Then it won’t be looking for me for sure.” Li Shi said in a sudden way.

sentences.simplified: “为什么？”霍桑抬起眼来看他。
sentences.traditional: “為什麼？”霍桑抬起眼來看他。
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me huò sāng tái qǐ yǎn lái kàn tā
sentences.english: “Why?” Huo Sang lifted his gaze to look at him.

sentences.simplified: “我脖子上戴着祖传的宝物，
sentences.traditional: “我脖子上戴著祖傳的寶物，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bó zi shang dài zhe zǔ chuán de bǎo wù
sentences.english: “I’m wearing a treasure on my neck that’s been passed on for generations.

sentences.simplified: 鬼可不敢来找我。”
sentences.traditional: 鬼可不敢來找我。”
sentences.pinyin: guǐ kě bù gǎn lái zhǎo wǒ
sentences.english: A ghost really wouldn’t dare come looking for me.”

sentences.simplified: 李时回答的时候，旁边有一个人干咳了一下，是那位很瘦的朱龙。
sentences.traditional: 李時回答的時候，旁邊有一個人乾咳了一下，是那位很瘦的朱龍。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí huí dá de shí hou páng biān yǒu yí ge rén gān ké le yí xià shì nà wèi hěn shòu de zhū lóng
sentences.english: When Li Shi answered, there was someone that coughed dryly next to him. It was that very thin Zhu Long.

sentences.simplified: “呀！宝物！在脖子里……”霍桑突然兴奋起来。
sentences.traditional: “呀！寶物！在脖子裡……”霍桑突然興奮起來。
sentences.pinyin: ya bǎo wù zài bó zi lǐ huò sāng tū rán xīng fèn qǐ lái
sentences.english: “Ah! Treasure! Around the neck…” Huo Sang suddenly got excited.

sentences.simplified: 他想：听说昨晚主人李时和主妇文华互换了睡觉的方向。
sentences.traditional: 他想：聽說昨晚主人李時和主婦文華互換了睡覺的方向。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng tīng shuō zuó wǎn zhǔ rén lǐ shí hé zhǔ fù wén huá hù huàn le shuì jiào de fāng xiàng
sentences.english: He thought: I heard that the owner Li Shi and the housewife Wen Hua exchanged sleeping positions last night.

sentences.simplified: 而那黑暗中的手，又两次都是摸在主妇的脖子上。
sentences.traditional: 而那黑暗中的手，又兩次都是摸在主婦的脖子上。
sentences.pinyin: ér nà hēi àn zhōng de shǒu yòu liǎng cì dōu shì mō zài zhǔ fù de bó zi shang
sentences.english: And those hands in the darkness touched the housewife’s neck both times.

sentences.simplified: 有没有可能，那两只怪手本来要摸的是主人李时的脖子，
sentences.traditional: 有沒有可能，那兩隻怪手本來要摸的是主人李時的脖子，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu méi yǒu kě néng nà liǎng zhī guài shǒu běn lái yào mō de shì zhǔ rén lǐ shí de bó zi
sentences.english: Is it possible that it was the owner Li Shi’s neck that those two strange hands originally wanted to touch, ..

sentences.simplified: 却误摸到了主妇的脖子上呢？
sentences.traditional: 卻誤摸到了主婦的脖子上呢？
sentences.pinyin: què wù mō dào le zhǔ fù de bó zi shang ne
sentences.english: .. yet they mistakenly touched the housewife’s neck?

sentences.simplified: “请问，那是一件什么宝物呢？”霍桑问道。
sentences.traditional: “請問，那是一件什麼寶物呢？”霍桑問道。
sentences.pinyin: qǐng wèn nà shì yí jiàn shén me bǎo wù ne huò sāng wèn dào
sentences.english: “May I ask, what treasure is that then?” Huo Sang asked.

sentences.simplified: 这是这位大侦探进门以后第一次发出兴奋的声音。
sentences.traditional: 這是這位大偵探進門以後第一次發出興奮的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì zhè wèi dà zhēn tàn jìn mén yǐ hòu dì yī cì fā chū xīng fèn de shēng yīn
sentences.english: This was the first time since this great detective entered the door that his voice expressed excitement.

sentences.simplified: “那是我曾祖父留下来的东西，听说是他从外国带回来的。
sentences.traditional: “那是我曾祖父留下來的東西，聽說是他從外國帶回來的。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì wǒ zēng zǔ fù liú xia lai de dōng xi tīng shuō shì tā cóng wài guó dài huí lái de
sentences.english: “It’s a thing that’s left from my paternal great-grandfather. I’ve heard that he brought it back home from abroad.

sentences.simplified: 不是很值钱，但是有辟邪的作用。
sentences.traditional: 不是很值錢，但是有辟邪的作用。
sentences.pinyin: bú shì hěn zhí qián dàn shì yǒu bì xié de zuò yòng
sentences.english: It’s not very valuable, but it works to ward off evil spirits.

sentences.simplified: 我从小戴在身上，就一直没有遇到过什么鬼啊怪啊的。”李时说。
sentences.traditional: 我從小戴在身上，就一直沒有遇到過什麼鬼啊怪啊的。”李時說。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ cóng xiǎo dài zài shēn shang jiù yì zhí méi yǒu yù dào guò shén me guǐ a guài a de lǐ shí shuō
sentences.english: I’ve had it on me since I was little, and I haven’t ever run into any ghosts or monsters.” Li Shi said.

sentences.simplified: “可以给我看一下吗？”大侦探显得非常兴奋。
sentences.traditional: “可以給我看一下嗎？”大偵探顯得非常興奮。
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ gěi wǒ kàn yí xià ma dà zhēn tàn xiǎn de fēi cháng xīng fèn
sentences.english: “Will you let me see it?” The great detective seemed extremely excited.

sentences.simplified: 李时想了想，说：
sentences.traditional: 李時想了想，說：
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí xiǎng le xiǎng shuō
sentences.english: Li Shi thought for a bit and said:

sentences.simplified: “可以。那只是一条做工十分简单的小金龙。”
sentences.traditional: “可以。那只是一條做工十分簡單的小金龍。”
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ nà zhǐ shì yì tiáo zuò gōng shí fēn jiǎn dān de xiǎo jīn lóng
sentences.english: “Yes. It’s only a completely ordinary handmade small golden dragon.”

sentences.simplified: 他从他的脖子上取下了一条金链。
sentences.traditional: 他從他的脖子上取下了一條金鏈。
sentences.pinyin: tā cóng tā de bó zi shang qǔ xià le yì tiáo jīn liàn
sentences.english: He took down the gold chain from his neck.

sentences.simplified: 在这金链上挂着一个黄色的小布袋，想必小金龙就藏在这布袋里面。
sentences.traditional: 在這金鏈上掛著一個黃色的小布袋，想必小金龍就藏在這布袋裡面。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè jīn liàn shang guà zhe yí ge huáng sè de xiǎo bù dài xiǎng bì xiǎo jīn lóng jiù cáng zài zhè bù dài lǐ miàn
sentences.english: A small yellow pouch was hanging from the gold chain. Presumably, the small golden dragon was hidden inside this pouch.

sentences.simplified: 李时取下小布袋时，显得十分认真。
sentences.traditional: 李時取下小布袋時，顯得十分認真。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí qǔ xià xiǎo bù dài shí xiǎn de shí fēn rèn zhēn
sentences.english: When Li Shi took down the small pouch, he looked very serious.

sentences.simplified: 霍桑正要接过布袋，李时的手却停了下来。
sentences.traditional: 霍桑正要接過布袋，李時的手卻停了下來。
sentences.pinyin: huò sāng zhèng yào jiē guò bù dài lǐ shí de shǒu què tíng le xia lai
sentences.english: Just when Huo Sang was going to take the offered pouch, Li Shi’s hand stopped.

raw.synopsis: This is Part 3 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.
sentence_translations: An hour later, this great detective Huo Sang arrived at Li Shi’s home.
Li Shi, Zhu Long, Xiaofeng and other servants all looked at this great detective that was famous nationwide.
They all got the feeling, that apart from a quite particular big red mark on this great detective’s ear, ..
.. there wasn’t anything special here.
His clothes were very big and very worn, and his shoes were also very dirty.
This great detective asked Li Shi a lot of questions. After that he sat down on the sofa, thinking about the whole matter.
He went over what Li Shi had said in his mind.
He thought: Last night someone certainly came into their room, ..
.. wanting to use the knockout drops, to incapacitate the person sleeping in the bed.
But I don’t know why it wasn’t done successfully. What purpose did this person have then? To steal something?
If it was to steal something, there are a lot of gold watches and gold bracelets in this room, ..
.. but none of them have been stolen away;
To kill someone? If it was to kill someone, that also seems unlikely.
If they wanted to kill someone, Wen Hua wouldn’t just be having a fever.
They didn’t want to steal anything, and also didn’t want to kill anyone.
Then what purpose did this person have in the end to come into this room?
Huo Sang thought while he took out a cigarette, and took a drag every now and then;
The housewife Wen Hua said that she was completely woken up the second time by that very cold hand.
That is to say, the hand the first time must not have been any different from an ordinary person’s hand.
And because of that, she wasn’t afraid at all.
Taking this one step further we may know, that not only one, but two people entered this room last night.
Then why was that second person’s hand so cold?
If it was someone from inside this house, they shouldn’t have cold hands since there are heaters in the house.
It is only under two circumstances, that hands get cold.
The first one is someone that just came into the house from outside.
Since it’s December now, the weather was both snowy and cold last night;
The second one is someone very thin. Someone like this has cold hands all through the whole winter.
Therefore, now we may know: there were two people that came into this room last night.
One that was inside the house, and one that came from the outside.
The first hand belonged to the one that was inside the house.
The second hand, that was as cold as a ghost, belonged to the one that came from the outside.
A well-coordinated attack! To spend so much effort, what purpose did they have in the end?
When he had thought this far, Huo Sang lifted his gaze and swept it over everyone in the room.
His look stopped for a few more seconds on two people, one fat and one thin.
All the while Li Shi looked at this great detective without saying anything, and couldn’t sit still.
He asked: “Excuse me, Mr. Huo, may I ask, that thing last night, was it done by a human or a ghost?”
Huo Sang smiled a bit, and said rather jokingly:
“This matter is so strange, it really is as if done by a ghost.”
“So it’s really a ghost! Then it won’t be looking for me for sure.” Li Shi said in a sudden way.
“Why?” Huo Sang lifted his gaze to look at him.
“I’m wearing a treasure on my neck that’s been passed on for generations.
A ghost really wouldn’t dare come looking for me.”
When Li Shi answered, there was someone that coughed dryly next to him. It was that very thin Zhu Long.
“Ah! Treasure! Around the neck…” Huo Sang suddenly got excited.
He thought: I heard that the owner Li Shi and the housewife Wen Hua exchanged sleeping positions last night.
And those hands in the darkness touched the housewife’s neck both times.
Is it possible that it was the owner Li Shi’s neck that those two strange hands originally wanted to touch, ..
.. yet they mistakenly touched the housewife’s neck?
“May I ask, what treasure is that then?” Huo Sang asked.
This was the first time since this great detective entered the door that his voice expressed excitement.
“It’s a thing that’s left from my paternal great-grandfather. I’ve heard that he brought it back home from abroad.
It’s not very valuable, but it works to ward off evil spirits.
I’ve had it on me since I was little, and I haven’t ever run into any ghosts or monsters.” Li Shi said.
“Will you let me see it?” The great detective seemed extremely excited.
Li Shi thought for a bit and said:
“Yes. It’s only a completely ordinary handmade small golden dragon.”
He took down the gold chain from his neck.
A small yellow pouch was hanging from the gold chain. Presumably, the small golden dragon was hidden inside this pouch.
When Li Shi took down the small pouch, he looked very serious.
Just when Huo Sang was going to take the offered pouch, Li Shi’s hand stopped.
